page.layout: One page of verse. At the head: running head "ESAYÆ." and page number 73 at top right. Above a horizontal rule: one stanza of seven lines. Below the rule: one block of twenty lines. No margin notes, no footer.

main_text.p: Victor peremit: vincula tunc piæ Amota sunt Genti Syonis, Tunc patrias repetiuit illa Sedes revulsis compedibus, Dei Ducente nutu: talibus & graues Regis ruinas tam ferocis Carminibus modulata risit.

Qui nunc quiescit prorsus, & impiys Turbare cunctas motibus abstinet Gentes Tyrannus? Qui potentes Diuitijs Babylon superbis Ciues inaurans nunc silei? [?] hoc manus Suprema fecit, docta Tyrannidis Vires nefandas, & furentis Imperium resecare sceptri. Qui subiugatas verbere terruit Plebes cruento, cuius & impetum Flammantis iræ sustinere Non poterat, nec acerba iussa Vitare quisquam, nunc fugit hostium Cursu sequentes præcipiti minas. Nunc terga dat cadenda sævis Arsacidum timidus cateruis. Quassata bellis tota nefariis Tellus Tyranno nunc colit ocium Cæso, triumphataque cantat Lætificum Babylone carmen.

page.notes: Printed text is verse; each block of lines is one stanza as printed, separated by the horizontal rule. "silei?" is doubtful. "resecare" is uncertain and may be "refecare" [?]. The printed letters "impiys" and "cuius" are as printed. The word "Tellus" has some damage in the scan but reads clearly enough. No marginal notes or catchword.
